title: Reader chapter progress counts synthetic preface as a numbered chapter
symptom: When opening the real corpus file `/Users/longshengxi/Downloads/小说测试集/我在古代搞建设.txt`, the reader top header shows `第1章 乘船` while the bottom page-mode progress shows `2/180章`. The mismatch is visible on the Pixel 8 / Android 14 emulator after revealing the reader chrome.
root_cause: ReaderScreen formatted bottom chapter progress from the selected chapter's raw position in the imported chapter list. ChapterAssembler intentionally inserts a non-empty leading `前言` chapter for front matter before the first detected heading, and OpeningChapterSelector intentionally opens the first non-preface chapter by default. The display layer then counted that synthetic preface as chapter 1, so the first real chapter displayed as position 2.
fix: Add ReaderChapterProgressFormatter as a pure reader display helper.
When the first imported chapter is a synthetic `前言` and later entries are real chapter titles, exclude that leading preface from numbered chapter progress.
Keep fallback `正文` chunks counted by raw position so long fallback imports still have stable progress.
Render the synthetic preface itself as `前言` instead of pretending it is a numbered chapter.
Route ReaderScreen progressSummary through the formatter without changing parser output, directory contents, anchor persistence, or chapter navigation.
failed_attempts: Do not fix this by removing the leading `前言` chapter from ChapterAssembler; it preserves real front matter offsets and content.
Do not change OpeningChapterSelector to open the preface just to make raw position counting line up; the existing default of opening the first non-preface chapter is intentional.
Do not reuse ChapterPatterns.isChapterTitle for this formatter without extending coverage, because it does not include numeric headings that the parser accepts.
impact: Keeps the visible chapter title and bottom progress label semantically aligned for real TXT files with front matter, reducing confusion in page-mode chrome.
